title: New ERA Energy & Digital, Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-14
summary: New Era Energy & Digital, Inc. (NUAI), an emerging growth company listed on Nasdaq, drew down $20 million in Term Loan A-1 financing and completed equity issuances to Macquarie Equipment Capital Inc. on April 13, 2026. The company issued warrants for 400,208 shares and sold 1,000,520 shares of common stock at approximately $5.00 per share, while underwriters exercised their option for an additional 4,477,611 shares. A Registration Rights Agreement was entered into with the lender.
key_points: Company drew down the entire $20 million Term Loan A-1 under a Term Loan Agreement with Macquarie Equipment Capital Inc.
Issued 400,208 warrants to purchase common stock with an exercise price of approximately $5.00 per share.
Sold 1,000,520 shares of common stock to the lender at approximately $5.00 per share.
Underwriters exercised their option on April 10, 2026 to purchase an additional 4,477,611 shares at the public offering price.
Company entered into a Registration Rights Agreement with the lender for resale of the securities.
The securities were issued under Section 4(a)(2) exemption from registration.
